page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; marginal references in the left margin, beside lines 3 and 13 of the column. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: operuit eos Spiritu soporis, & oculos eorum occlusit. Non autem ita avertit ab ipsis faciem suam, ut in perpetuum eos repudiaret: sed voluit ipsos hactenus Deut. 32.21. Ethnicorum prosperitate irritare, & provocare beatitudine gentis quondam stultae, atque a Dei cognitione abalienatae, quemadmodum patres ipsorum eum olim provocaverunt in falsis Dijs & vanis abominationibus. Citius tamen ipsis haec lux exorta fuisset, si voluntatem Domini in Lege & Prophetis zelo syncero scrutati, veri Messiae verissima indicia in Christo IEsv Domino nostro agnovissent: tunc enim quivis eorum in spiritu & certitudine fidei invocasset nomen Domini, quum jam recordentur quidem Dei Israelis, sed non in veritate & iustitia: quod Mich. 7.11. evenit eis juxta prophetiam Michaeae, qui ait; Die qua aedificabit Dominus maceries tuas, die illa elongabitur a te statutum: in ipsa regni Iudaici quae sub Messia expectabatur restauratione, sublatum iri a Iudaeis foedus Dei salutiferum indicans; terramque Sanctam vastitati & desolationi addicendam monens, dum addit: die illa & usque ad te veniet hostis Assur, & usque ad urbes munitas, & ab urbe munita usque ad flumen, & mare occiden-tale,

page.notes: The page is a single block of text; no headings or footnotes are printed. The catchword "tale," sits alone at the lower right and is recorded under bottom_margin. The stray mark between "&" and "oculos" in the first line is a printer's or ink artefact and is not transcribed. Long s is normalised to s throughout, and the ligatures in "fuisset", "agnovissent" and "invocasset" are written out in full. The small-capital "IEsv" is kept as printed.
